root_causes.title: Missing ownership enforcement
root_causes.summary: The order lookup trusted an object identifier without checking the authenticated owner.

condition_sweep.scope: src/**/*.ts route handlers and data access, excluding tests and fixtures
condition_sweep.note: Three further lookups share the missing owner predicate; none is filed yet.

seeded_check.seed_description: Planted the same missing owner predicate in the export job using a differently named accessor, so an expression fitted to the original call site would have missed it.

root_causes.title: Unbounded retry experience
root_causes.summary: The retry path is safe but does not explain how long recovery can take.

evidence.summary: Alice retrieved Bob's paid order by changing the order ID.
The recovery response has no pending-state explanation or retry horizon.

probabilistic-eval.reason: The fixture has no LLM, agent, or RAG behavior.

findings.title: Any signed-in user can read another user's order
findings.promise_or_invariant: A user can read only orders they own.
preconditions: Alice and Bob each have an order
reproduction_steps: Request Bob's order ID using Alice's session
findings.expected: The service denies or hides Bob's order.
findings.actual: The service returned Bob's complete order.
findings.impact: A customer can expose another customer's purchase data
findings.suspected_cause: Inference: the lookup filters by order ID but not authenticated owner.
findings.minimum_fix_or_agent_prompt: Bind every order read to both order ID and authenticated owner.
findings.acceptance_test: Repeat the cross-owner request and require 404, then confirm same-owner access succeeds.
findings.adjacent_regression_check: Exercise list, detail, and receipt routes for both owners.

findings.title: Timeout recovery does not explain when to retry
findings.promise_or_invariant: A timed-out customer can understand the order state and next action.
preconditions: Checkout times out after the order is accepted
reproduction_steps: Refresh the order page immediately after the timeout
findings.expected: The page explains the pending state and a safe retry horizon.
findings.actual: The page shows a generic pending label without timing guidance.
findings.impact: Some customers may retry unnecessarily or contact support
findings.suspected_cause: Inference: the recovery UI has no product copy for delayed completion.
findings.minimum_fix_or_agent_prompt: Add pending-state guidance and a safe retry horizon without changing order semantics.
findings.acceptance_test: A timed-out checkout displays the pending reason, safe next action, and retry horizon.
findings.adjacent_regression_check: Successful and failed checkouts retain their existing terminal messages.

unknowns.unresolved_condition: The final state after a client timeout has not been exercised.
unknowns.why_it_matters: A customer could lose confidence or repeat a completed order.
unknowns.missing_evidence: A timeout, refresh, and resume runtime trace.
unknowns.resolving_test: Interrupt checkout after acceptance, refresh, and inspect the recovered state.
